message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: A group helps fraudsters (online) withdraw money from bank accounts after the fraudsters have transferred money into those accounts. They take the bank cards, go to bank, withdraw cash, and return cash to the organizer. This is facilitating fraud? The primary crime is fraud (诈骗) because they are part of the scheme to defraud victims. However they are not the ones directly deceiving victims; they are taking money after fraud is done. Could be "诈骗" (fraud) as principal participants. Also could be "帮助诈骗" but not in label list. The correction lessons mention "票据诈骗;信用卡诈骗;合同诈骗" as specific types, but here it's general fraud (online). So label likely "诈骗". Also maybe "组织、领导传销活动"? No. Not.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>

Check if any other label needed: maybe "帮助诈骗" not in list. So just 诈骗.

Return JSON.
